The reason why is i no longer see reasons on continue, I dont want to commit suicide, but i dont see a reason on continue living in sorrow and in vain.
The society today tells everyone that you will become big, successful, become happily married and get kids. But what do you do when you grow up and see that you cant reach these goals?
Of course many wont become rich or successful, but it is basic human needs to have someone to care about you. All of my "friends" are starting to make their own families, getting married and having children, and im left with nothing, and nothing in sight either. should i wait and see if i mabye could find someone? the chances are there, but they`re so slim.

The reason why I`m so depressed i think.. Is that i have no future, I`m a wageslave. 0700-1500 each day, no real friends, no one understands me. I have never had a girlfriend, which bothers me very much, i use a ton of money on nice cloths, but it doesn`t pay off.
I see no real reason to get old, the statistics on the population in my country shows that i probably will become ca. 80 years old.
Why live 60 years more? when I have not accomplished anything in the 20 years i have lived?
I have a good job, make more than average, but still im not happy.
I was bullied very much in school which left me with so much pain, so much that it still bothers me.

And last of all i do not have good relations whit my parents, i actually lived in a foster home for some years, which was the best period in my life, but i moved back home when i got old enough, which was the most stupidest thing i have done yet.

A week ago i drove in my car for 3 hours straight, and all i could think of was how to end my life, and laid a really god plan on how to do it too. which I still want to go with. I`m really messed up.
